---
title: "PPT Demo"
format: pptx
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(flextable)
```

## Analysis

Here we find the maximum theophylline concentration for each subject.


```{r}
Theoph |> 
    group_by(Subject) |> 
    summarize(cmax = max(conc)) |> 
    arrange(as.numeric(as.character(Subject))) |> 
    flextable()
```

## Plots

Plot 


```{r}
Theoph |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = Time, y = conc, group = Subject)) + 
    geom_line()
```
